sections.description: Lightweight, deterministic, ECV-style B2B inquiry & lead generation chatbot for WordPress. 100% conversion focused, direct email gate, zero LLM cost, instant notifications.
sections.changelog:
1.4.3 (2026-10-24)

  • 全面升级后台为交互式可视化表单流程与问答规则编辑器，支持自由增删与上下移排序。
  • 管理后台全界面深度纯简体中文汉化。

1.4.2 (2026-10-24)

  • Added native 1-click and background automatic update capability.
  • Optimized 10-field database schema and payload_json unification.
  • Compact single-screen Feishu interactive card without redundant action buttons.

1.4.1

  • Fixed mobile viewport flex layout and generic page greetings.

1.4.0

  • Bilingual English/Chinese configuration and presets.
